items.title: Netflix, Nucor, On Holding, Xenon, Accenture, Coinbase, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite rebounded to end Friday’s session slightly higher after spending most of the day in the red.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended lower as higher oil prices and bond yields weighed on equities.  Glassmaker  Corning  and optical networking stocks  Coherent  and  Lumentum  rose, while chip manufacturer  Intel  fell 0.2%.

items.title: Bet on These Photonics ETFs to Exploit the Next Wave of AI Revolution
items.summary: Photonics is emerging as a key AI infrastructure technology, with surging investments and growth projections fueling interest in ETFs.

items.title: Coherent's Datacenter Business Powers its Revenue Growth
items.summary: COHR's fiscal Q4 revenues climb to $2.05 billion as datacenter and communications demand drive nearly 79% of sales and offset industrial weakness.

items.title: What's Moving Markets Today?
items.summary: Major indexes edged lower as the yield on the 10-year Treasury note pushed past 5%. Markets have had a lot to digest this week: a quarter-point interest-rate hike, fluctuating fuel prices and big tech's P(doom)--aka the probability that AI results in a existentially catastrophic outcome, according to the Silicon Valley ecosystem.

items.title: Is Coherent Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
items.summary: Due to Coherent’s outperformance relative to the S&P 500 Index over the past year, analysts are bullish about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Lumentum Climbs 3% as Optics Buying Extends; Coherent Rises 5%, Corning Jumps 3%
items.summary: Optics stocks are surging again while the broader market slides, and no earnings release or analyst upgrade explains the buying. Something else is pulling capital into this group, and the answer matters for anyone holding names that are already up triple digits this year.

items.title: Ciena Stock Rises as These Numbers Leave Wall Street Pleasantly Surprised
items.summary: It’s been a difficult week for the performance of shares of optical networking companies as existential artificial-intelligence fears hit the stock market.  Ciena stock rose 3% to $350.85 on Thursday.  Ciena was at least partially responsible for the stock performances on Thursday as the company’s financial guidance pointed to little to no slowdown in AI demand for networking products.
